objective: Repair Freezegun so as_arg decorator injection invokes the decorated callable once while preserving as_kwarg and conflict behavior.
acceptance: The authored reproduction passes on the repaired source and fails on the pinned pre-fix source.
as_arg injects the time factory before original positional arguments without a second invocation.
as_kwarg, generator decoration, and rejection of both injection modes remain correct.
The repair is limited to the supplied Freezegun source snapshot and is deterministic offline.
